In a company of 50 employees, 20% of the employees are management.  Out of this 20%, only 30% oversee the entire company.  How many employees oversee the company?

End your reply with a line of the form 'Final answer: N', where N is the final number.

20% of 50 employees are management:

- \(50 \times 0.20 = 10\) management employees

30% of those oversee the entire company:

- \(10 \times 0.30 = 3\)

Final answer: 3
